scope: Review PIPE-P07 capacity and the feasibility of a 600 mm to 750 mm upgrade. Verify dimensions, road levels, utilities and downstream capacity before proposing construction.
justification: The sampled peak at the selected road point is 52.2 cm lower. Study: D07 street junction, 784 m2 of road cells. R1 sampled peak: 60.0 cm before, 7.7 cm after. Maximum simultaneous road area at or above 15 cm: 760 m2 before, 0 m2 after. Approximate R1 duration above reference: 75.0 / 0.0 minutes (before / after, 30-second samples). Browser-engine scenario only. Road cells exclude grates and manhole footprints. Terrain is synthetic, not surveyed pavement; the reference is not a safety standard. Site and surface validation are not established. Verify inputs, downstream constraints, access and actual cost before approval. Related complaint: DEMO-C01. D07 inspection reference: DEMO-INSP-D07-001. Request survey and engineering review; no construction approval is requested.

estimate.source: No engineering-review quotation obtained - cost unknown.
estimate.exclusions: Review cost and construction cost are unknown. Survey, utilities, downstream capacity, approvals and reinstatement require confirmation. No savings are claimed.

assumptions: 2D surface flow on a 2 m grid coupled to capacity-routed pipes; SWMM-style catchments through grate capture.
Synthetic Taman Kyra network (Tay Zheheng) and layout (TEH JIA JIE); not a surveyed site.

status_definitions.flooding: manhole full and street wet at its cell

metric_definitions.total_flooding_volume_m3: Sum of individual cell peak water volumes where depth reaches ≥15 cm; not a simultaneous peak (pond/canal excluded)
metric_definitions.surcharge_duration_s: Approximate time any selected trunk pipe reaches ≥99.9% of model flow capacity, sampled from output frames; not pressure-based surcharge
